applies_to: VTS CO2-SENS-D-MODRTU duct CO2 transducer (MH-Z19B sensing module), manual ver. 2.0 (11.2021).
summary: A duct-mounted CO2 transducer from VTS with a 0-5/0-10 V output and an RS-485 Modbus RTU interface. The measurement, sensor status and a fixed test value sit in the first three holding registers; configuration is done by writing a password, command and parameter into three registers. All registers are plain 16-bit values read with function 03.

addressing.note: The register map lists addresses in hex from 0x0000, and the DEV_ID description gives 'addr=11=0x000B', so the printed value is the wire address.

source.title: CO2 Transducer CO2-SENS-D-MODRTU
source.pages: Section 4.1 register map and command table, pp. 10-12

notes: All registers are 16-bit; there are no 32-bit values in this map.

Command parameters: 1 = address 1-247 (default 1); 2 = baud code 24/48/96/192/384/576/1152 for 2400-115200 bit/s (default 192 = 19200); 3 = parity 0 none (default), 1 even, 2 odd; 4 = stop bits 1 (default) or 2; 5 = ABClogic 0 off (default) / 1 on; 6 = 1 software reset of device, 2 reset of sensor module.

The defaults above are the software-configuration defaults from the command table. The DIP switches can override baud rate, parity and address; their factory positions are marked in bold in the manual and could not be confirmed from the text.
Reserved registers 0x0006-0x000A read 0 and are not listed. Reading any address not in the map returns exception 02.
The manual lists functions 03, 06 and 16 only; use function 03 (read holding registers) for all reads.

registers.name: TEST_VAL_REG
registers.description: Always 1000 (0x03E8); use it to check reads are correct.

registers.name: PASS_REG (password)
registers.description: Write 1234 (0x04D2) to execute the command in COMMAND_REG/PARAM_REG.

registers.name: COMMAND_REG
registers.description: Command number; reads 0xEEEE after an invalid parameter.

registers.name: PARAM_REG
registers.description: Parameter for the command; see notes for the value list per command.

bits.4-8: OPTIONS: device type (b10000 = CO2 transducer with MH-Z19B)

registers.name: SOFT_VER_REG (software version)
registers.description: Four nibbles N.AB + revision letter, e.g. 0x3210 = 3.21a.

integration.summary: Read three holding registers from 0x0000 with function 03: CO2 in ppm, status, and the 1000 test value. Check status is 1 before trusting the reading.

minimum_registers.why: Fixed 1000 test value for comms check

integration.enable: Modbus RTU is always active. To change settings write password 1234, command and parameter to 0x0003-0x0005 in one function 16 write, or write command and parameter first and the password last.
quirks: An invalid or out-of-range parameter makes COMMAND_REG read 0xEEEE instead of executing.
Status reads 3 (warm up) for the first 3 minutes after power-on.
setup: Left DIP switch: switch 1 = 120 ohm termination, 2 = analogue range 0-5 V or 0-10 V, 3-4 = parity/stop bits or 'use software settings', 5-6 = baud 2400-19200.
Right DIP switch sets the address in binary (switch 1 = +1 ... switch 8 = +128).
DIP switch changes are read only at start-up: press RESET or cycle power after changing them.
gotchas: The DIP switches only offer 2400-19200 baud; 38400-115200 can only be set through the command registers.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
